story.iWant: Vercel AI SDK and Mem0 packages installed with environment configuration
story.soThat: the AI infrastructure dependencies are available for development

subtasks.subtask: Run `pnpm add ai @ai-sdk/anthropic @ai-sdk/openai mem0ai` in apps/designer

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: `.env.template` updated with AI_PROVIDER, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, MEM0_API_KEY, AI_MODEL
Environment variables have clear comments explaining usage
No NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix on any AI-related environment variables (server-side only)

doc.title: Technical Specification: Vercel AI SDK + Mem0 Integration
Technical Specification: Vercel AI SDK + Mem0 Integration
doc.snippet: Defines AI_PROVIDER (anthropic|openai), API keys, AI_MODEL override. Security note: No NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix - server-side only.

doc.title: Coding Standards
doc.snippet: Follow existing patterns, explicit is better than implicit, code should be self-documenting with clear naming.

file.reason: Target file for adding new AI packages to dependencies section
Target file for adding AI-related environment variables

constraints.constraint: No NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix on environment variables - all AI keys are server-side only
Install packages only in apps/designer, not in shared packages
Use exact package names as specified in spec: ai, @ai-sdk/anthropic, @ai-sdk/openai, mem0ai
Default AI_PROVIDER to "anthropic", default models: claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022 (Anthropic), gpt-4o (OpenAI)

interface.name: Environment Variables
interface.signature: AI_PROVIDER=anthropic|openai (default: anthropic) ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=string (required if AI_PROVIDER=anthropic) OPENAI_API_KEY=string (required if AI_PROVIDER=openai) MEM0_API_KEY=string (required) AI_MODEL=string (optional, overrides provider default)

tests.standards: No unit tests required for this story. This is a package installation and environment configuration task. Verification is done by checking package.json and .env.template files.
tests.locations: N/A - no tests for this story
